next_prs.title: Give shared workload transport an honest home
next_prs.scope: Move environment_runtime_transport, its Python config and testing helpers together. The Go library depends on SPIFFE and gRPC, not the identity resolver or issuer, so placing it below identity does not itself create a cycle. Update every Go/Python import, Bazel label, cdk8s setting reference and document. Keep transport policy and credential resolution in their existing roles.
next_prs.invariant: Preserve TLS verification, URI and EKU validation, SPIFFE trust domains, expiry behavior, token audiences and configuration keys. Do not absorb resolver or issuer logic in this move.
next_prs.check: Run the relocated transport race suite; build credential resolver and issuer, affected Go binaries and Python settings/cdk8s libraries. Search the entire repository for the old path; remaining active references must be zero.
next_prs.dependency: No content dependency on the remaining open PRs; reconcile overlapping imports by rebasing.

next_prs.title: Extract sampler configuration and model-route settings
next_prs.scope: Move Settings, ModelConfig, ConnectionConfig, AuthConfig, decoding, validation and their methods from settings.go into a public settings package. Keep the configuration family together; split the 441-line implementation into decoding, model/connection settings and validation files as useful. Update sampler, command and History integration callers to name the defining package directly. Move settings tests; keep test fixture builders with their consumers.
next_prs.invariant: The file imports provider adapters, protocol and shared transport, with no sampler-root dependency. Preserve unknown-key rejection, defaults, model compatibility, credential reading, gateway address checks and timeout budgets. Keep the Python rendering schema and its keys stable; add no type aliases or re-exports.
next_prs.check: Run relocated settings tests and central_sampler_unit_test, build the sampler command, and run the existing History ingress and sampler service tests that construct these settings.
next_prs.dependency: Independent of lane 1; update transport imports again if its move lands first.

next_prs.title: Extract the sampler code-mode tool contract
next_prs.readiness: Ready with a bounded parser split
next_prs.scope: Move codemode_description.go, its embedded templates and description tests, plus the pure exec/wait input types and parsers from codemode.go and tool_protocol.go. Make the schema reflector and decoder use the same concrete input types. Keep prepareExecute, prepareJSONCall and other methods that touch CodeMode, Store or a live host in the sampler root.
next_prs.invariant: Preserve freeform and JSON contracts, safe-integer checks, unknown-field rejection, defaults, code-tool ordering and schema behavior. Leave journal writes, live-cell handles, admission and cancellation with their current owners. Pure parsing must not import the sampler root or require callback plumbing.
next_prs.check: Run the moved description/input tests, existing code-mode execution and unit suites, and build the command including embedded template runfiles. Verify both exec encodings with existing provider/service coverage.
next_prs.dependency: Independent of settings extraction. Shared edits in codemode.go are rebase work, not a reason to serialize ready PRs.

next_prs.title: Extract sampler tool-result decoding and rendering
next_prs.scope: Move codemode_output.go, codemode_protocol.go, output_truncation.go and their tests into one result-decoding/rendering package. Keep observation types concrete. Pass the resolved output budget into rendering so output code does not depend on the root tool-description constants. Update process-output callers as well as CodeMode.Execute.
next_prs.invariant: Preserve UTF-8 boundaries, omission markers, image/audio accounting, strict result variants, host duration and error rendering. Keep CodeMode.observe and all Store writes in the coordinator; parsing and rendering must not acquire a lease or touch the executor.
next_prs.check: Run the relocated protocol/output tests and existing sampler unit and execution tests. Retain behavior coverage for mixed content, failed/yielded cells, process output truncation and image preparation.
next_prs.dependency: Can start alongside lane 3. Resolve the default budget at its caller rather than creating a dependency on the tool-contract package.

next_prs.title: Make History projection and cursor walking private
next_prs.scope: Move the existing projection and settledcursors Go packages and tests under History internal. There are nine projection import files and three cursor-helper import files, all inside History. Update read/watch handlers, settlement backfill, ingress recovery tests and the fold package together; leave Python fold/models.py and its browser-sync consumers at their established boundary.
next_prs.invariant: Keep leases, cursor coverage, checkpoint commits, settlement rules and stored schemas unchanged. Preserve the real sampler-to-History projection scenarios landed in #16080.
next_prs.check: Run relocated projection lifecycle/integration and cursor tests, the History read integration suite and ingress integration suite, and build the History binary. Reuse existing scale coverage if the diff changes its setup; a path-only move does not call for a new performance claim.
next_prs.dependency: Do not duplicate #16094 or #16105. Their package moves may cause import conflicts; these are not content prerequisites. Recheck their landed paths at dispatch.

next_prs.title: Make History ingress implementation private
next_prs.scope: Move ingress implementation and its full integration harness under internal, updating main.go and Bazel labels. The only Go import of the implementation is History main. Public producer contracts stay in api/ingress; include the producer-to-History scenarios and real exporter in the relocated test target.
next_prs.invariant: Preserve SVID/delegated authorization, Sandbox UID validation, bounds, duplicate handling and acknowledgement timing. Keep the producer fixture dependent on public sampler APIs and its explicit historyexport boundary.
next_prs.check: Run the relocated ingress integration suite and History startup/integration suites; build history-service and the Runtime/sampler exporters. Search all repository references, including test target selectors and docs, for the old implementation path.
next_prs.dependency: Independent of lane 5 and the landed storage move; rebase shared BUILD/import edits. If a test actually depends on an unmerged commit, use a native GitHub stack.
